name: Held Fist
description: Hold the fist back a heartbeat longer than the body wants and then loose it with the whole held will.

name: Held Shield
description: Hold the guard through the first blow and the second and let the resolve harden the arms each time.

name: Held Pace
description: Take a long even pace without letting the pain in the legs shorten it.

name: Gritted Will
description: Clench the jaw and push the will down through a wounded body so that it keeps working past its limit.

name: Held Throw
description: Hold a gathered lump of qi at the fingertips until the will is ready and then fling it at the target.

name: Dogged Press
description: Press on the opponent's arms without easing until their qi flags under the unrelenting pressure.

name: Resolute Bracing
description: Hold a stance past the point of pain while a dense shell of resolved qi shrugs off blow after blow.

name: Spent Resolve
description: Spend the whole held resolve in one blow that lands hard and throws the opponent's stance apart.

name: Willed Push
description: Thrust the palm out and send an unseen push of will across a short gap into the target's chest.

name: Willed Ward
description: Throw up a flat shield of pure will in front of the body to soften an incoming blow.

name: Willed Dash
description: Will the body forward in a quick dash as though pulled by a rope from the far side.

name: Force Nudge
description: Nudge the opponent's weapon arm off its line with a light push of will from a pace away.

name: Force Lend
description: Lend a measure of pushing will to an ally so their own blows come out heavier for a short time.

name: Willed Grasp
description: Close an unseen hand of will on the opponent and strike them so the blow lands and their balance goes.

name: Force Curtain
description: Hang a curtain of pushing will before the body that stops blows and shoves the attackers back a pace.

name: Stern Word
description: Speak one stern word so that the opponent's body flinches before the mind can choose.

name: Sentencing Hand
description: Bring a heavy open hand down on the opponent as though handing down a sentence.

name: Obeyed Guard
description: Order the qi to take the blow in place of the body and let it obey at once.

name: Summoned Pace
description: Call the body to the far mark with one word and cross the distance in a single stride.

name: Level Tone
description: Speak to a rattled ally in a level tone and let the will inside it settle their breath and hands.

name: Whisper Order
description: Breathe a quiet order into the room and feel which minds bend toward it and which push back.

name: Binding Command
description: Speak a command that freezes the opponent's limbs in the posture they held when it was spoken.

name: Hard Compel
description: Compel the opponent to lower the weapon with a hard order and press their qi down while they obey.

name: Withdrawn Order
description: Speak a counter-order to an ally who has been compelled and strip the foreign command out of their mind.

name: Stubborn Jab
description: Snap out a plain jab and drive it again and again at the same spot without changing the line.

name: Mind Plate
description: Lay a flat plate of firm will over the chest so that pressure meets nothing it can bend.

name: Rigid Step
description: Advance in short stiff steps that keep the spine straight and refuse any swerve.

name: Iron Calm
description: Breathe out an iron calm that spreads to the nearest ally and steadies their qi against shock.

name: Unbowed Brow
description: Raise the head against a crushing pressure and let the shell of will throw the pressure back on its source.

name: Shrugged Dread
description: Shake off a cast of dread from an ally by driving a firm will through the fear that clings to them.

name: Tenfold Jab
description: Throw ten fast jabs where each one is aimed by its own thread of intent at a different spot.

name: Tenfold Guard
description: Spread ten thin guards of qi over the body so that each blow meets one of them.

name: Tenfold Stride
description: Break a long stride into ten small bounds each timed by a separate thread of intent.

name: Split Intent
description: Split one intent into two lumps of qi and send them at two points of the target together.

name: Parted Aim
description: Part the aim in three and loose three small shots of will that spread slightly as they cross the gap.

name: Tenfold Breath
description: Count ten slow breaths and feel through each one a different quarter of the surrounding ground.

name: Shared Intent
description: Hand one thread of the ten to an ally so that their own aim sharpens to match the user's.

name: Tenfold Scatter
description: Scatter ten lines of will across the nearby foes so that each of them takes a sharp thump.

name: Braided Intent
description: Braid several lines of intent together over the user and a close ally so one shell guards both.

name: Tenfold Lash
description: Lash out with all ten threads at one man so the blows land in a rattling rush and break his stance.

name: Foretold Jab
description: Strike at the spot where the opponent's intent says the guard will open a heartbeat later.

name: Foretold Guard
description: Feel the blow coming in the opponent's intent and turn it aside before it has fully started.

name: Foretold Step
description: Step out of the line of a blow that has not yet been thrown.

name: Tell Reader
description: Watch the small tells of a person's shoulders and breath and feel what they mean to do next.

name: Clear Head
description: Tap an ally's brow and push a clear will into the mind so that the haze of fear thins.

name: Cleared Dread
description: Read the dread laid on an ally by a hostile will and wash it out of the mind a layer at a time.

name: Foretold Counter
description: Read the coming blow in the opponent's intent and turn it aside while striking the opening it leaves.

name: Rally Fist
description: Raise a fist to show the others where the line is holding and strike the one in front.

name: Rally Guard
description: Hold the guard high so that those behind the user take heart from it and from its firmness.

name: Rally Step
description: Step forward first so the others follow in the same moment and the gap closes.

name: Rally Cry
description: Cry a single rousing word that sets the will of every ally in earshot and quickens their blows.

name: Heartening Hand
description: Clasp an ally's forearm and pass across a calm firm will that returns the colour to their face.

name: Rousing Nudge
description: Shove a flagging ally between the shoulder blades and shock their will back into the fight.

name: Pooled Resolve
description: Spread the user's resolve over every ally within reach so their qi steadies and their strikes hold together.

name: Rally Surge
description: Send a surge of rallying will through the nearby allies that sets a faint shell over each and quickens them.
